name: Arctic Linux 1.2.0
body:
Arctic Linux 1.2 is a Fedora 44 based live and installable desktop for x86_64, with Mango, Zen Browser, and DNF, Flatpak and Nix integration.

This release preserves the exact ISO qualified in [workflow run 37218930813](https://github.com/yuvalkolodkingal/Arctic-Linux/actions/runs/37218930813), built from commit `d13da6c907460136fc22017314112ce351592a3f`. It was not rebuilt for publication. ISO size: **2,322,073,600 bytes**.

### Download and assemble

GitHub limits each release asset to less than 2 GiB. Download **both** ISO parts and the checksum file below. These are permanent release assets, not expiring Actions artifacts. Do not flash an individual part.

- [Part 00](https://github.com/yuvalkolodkingal/Arctic-Linux/releases/download/v1.2.0/Arctic-Linux-1.2-x86_64.iso.part00)
- [Part 01](https://github.com/yuvalkolodkingal/Arctic-Linux/releases/download/v1.2.0/Arctic-Linux-1.2-x86_64.iso.part01)
- [ISO SHA256](https://github.com/yuvalkolodkingal/Arctic-Linux/releases/download/v1.2.0/Arctic-Linux-1.2-x86_64.iso.sha256)
- [Part checksums](https://github.com/yuvalkolodkingal/Arctic-Linux/releases/download/v1.2.0/Arctic-Linux-1.2-x86_64.iso.parts.sha256)

Linux/macOS:

```sh
cat Arctic-Linux-1.2-x86_64.iso.part00 Arctic-Linux-1.2-x86_64.iso.part01 > Arctic-Linux-1.2-x86_64.iso
sha256sum -c Arctic-Linux-1.2-x86_64.iso.sha256
# macOS: shasum -a 256 -c Arctic-Linux-1.2-x86_64.iso.sha256
```

Windows PowerShell:

```powershell
cmd /c copy /b Arctic-Linux-1.2-x86_64.iso.part00+Arctic-Linux-1.2-x86_64.iso.part01 Arctic-Linux-1.2-x86_64.iso
Get-FileHash Arctic-Linux-1.2-x86_64.iso -Algorithm SHA256
```

Expected ISO SHA256:

```
054db5c43cae47fb60f8f43efc8e052b569aa1b14e8f15adcb15cdc48265182f
```

Write the verified, assembled ISO to a USB stick of at least 4 GB, for example with Fedora Media Writer. The boot menu offers Try Arctic Linux and Install Arctic Linux.

### What's included

- Dodge windows taskbar visibility alongside Always visible and Auto-hide, with a patched Mango geometry event bridge. Unsupported or disconnected sessions leave the bar visible.
- Get Apps restored to six cards in two rows; standalone Remove Apps remains available.
- Reliable update checks that report unavailable required Arctic metadata, retain valid queued downloads and permit another check. Fedora and Arctic package updates retain signature verification; the signed Arctic stable repository is enabled.
- Zen Browser preinstalled, plus the existing per-user Nix management, isolation, launcher and persistence integration.

### Validation and limits

All 26 pre-merge CI checks and 13 post-merge checks passed. Exact-source VM qualification recorded **44 passed, 0 failed, 1 unrun**: live boot, encrypted installation and reboot under SELinux Enforcing; Zen and Nix graphical launches; Nix install/update/remove/rollback, isolation and persistence; patched Mango capability and Dodge preference persistence. Repository metadata and release/settings/shell/Mango package signatures were verified with the existing Arctic key.

Nix engine-version migration was unrun because no newer engine was available. DNF refreshed repositories but found no package updates in this VM run. Real offline fixture transactions passed separately in a container; native graphical Polkit/offline-update boot remains unqualified. The Dodge author tested the exact transferred source in isolated native sessions; this is distinct from physical-display testing. Physical GPU, game, Secure Boot, monitor and other hardware compatibility are not established by this VM qualification. No all-hardware or all-game guarantee is made.
